Definition: from a presumed derivative of G5055; to finish life (by implication, of G979), i.e. expire (demise):--be dead, decease, die.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to finish life, to die. When Herod was dead, the angel appeared to Joseph in Egypt; Jacob went down into Egypt and died, he and the fathers; and Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the deaths in these verses are doorways: Herod's death frees Joseph to return, and Joseph's death points to the Exodus.
